$comment: FCU GSI Digital & Creative Solutions Intake — the second built-in list form on the same list as gsi-digital-initiatives-intake.json (Creative Services Intake on FCUCommunicationsSecurityAwareness, addressed by URL; display name 'Creative Digital Solutions Inake'). Straight submit, one page, no branching. Columns are INTERNAL names (field_6 = Requested Launch Date, field_7 = Links/Location, field_9 = Description, Pillar_x002f_Partner = Pillar/Partner). Priority is a switch that writes 'Urgent' or 'Standard' (neither is a list choice yet; REST accepts it). Business time: Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00 Eastern, holidays not modeled; a launch date means 5pm Eastern that day (businessHours.dateAt). One business day = 8 working hours, i.e. the user's '24 hours'. A launch date within one business day opens the urgent prompt and locks Priority on Urgent.

form.title: FCU GSI Digital & Creative Solutions Intake
form.intro: These services are provided by the Digital & Creative Solutions team, a part of FCU Governance, Strategy and Integration. To submit intakes for other GSI services, including FCU Communications and OCM, use the [GSI intake](/sites/FCUPortal/Go#gsi-intake).

confirmation.title: Request submitted
confirmation.message: Your request has been logged with the Digital & Creative Solutions team. You'll hear from us with any follow-up questions.

sections.title: Who's involved
sections.description: The lead contact, the team the work is for, and anyone else to keep in the loop.

fields.label: Requestor
fields.hint: Yourself or else the lead contact for the request.

fields.label: Department
fields.hint: Department or team that is the stakeholder of the deliverable (usually your team).

fields.label: Partners
fields.hint: Any additional contacts to include with this project.

fields.label: Title
fields.hint: A short title describing your request. Leave it blank and we'll name it from your team and today's date.

fields.label: Pillar/Partner
fields.hint: Your department and any others the request serves.

fields.label: Requested launch date
fields.hint: Please allow a minimum of 2 business days when possible.

rules.message: The launch date can't be in the past.

prompt.title: Next business day request
prompt.message: For next business day requests, your intake will be marked urgent in order to accommodate your business need. Thank you!

fields.label: Priority
fields.lockNote: Needed within one business day, so this request is urgent. Pick a later launch date to change it.

sections.title: Details
sections.description: The more we know up front, the fewer follow-up questions.

fields.label: Description
fields.hint: Please include all specific information needed to complete your request. If you require consultation, please indicate.

fields.label: Links/Location
fields.hint: Include any SharePoint or other links relevant to your request. If your request involves a specific site or page, include the link here.
